name: Builder Product
best_for: App builders or coding agents turning incomplete product intent into a specific full-stack SaaS execution contract.
quality_gates: Vertical Blueprint before final plan and tasks
anti-genericity constraints tied to domain workflow
known_limits: Does not choose a stack automatically and does not generate a finished product by itself.

name: Targeted Change Brownfield
best_for: Small brownfield fixes where the agent must inspect before edit, identify exact files, and avoid broad refactors.
known_limits: Not appropriate for greenfield product generation or large architecture redesign.

name: Internal PDF RAG Assistant
best_for: Internal document assistants that must answer from approved PDFs with citations, access control, refusal behavior, and freshness rules.
quality_gates: citation accuracy checked against source chunks
unsupported answers refused with no invented citations
known_limits: Structural evaluation only unless paired with a separate semantic review process.

name: B2B Internal SaaS
best_for: Internal SaaS workflows with roles, approvals, persistent state, privacy, and audit requirements.
quality_gates: explicit RBAC for employee and manager actions
payroll or unrelated suite scope rejected
known_limits: Does not include payroll, HRIS, billing, or enterprise integration scope unless specified.

name: Multi-Agent Control
best_for: Governed multi-agent workflows where roles, permissions, tools, stop conditions, and release gates must be explicit.
quality_gates: role boundaries declared for every agent
stop conditions documented before tool use
known_limits: Does not grant autonomous authority for destructive actions or sensitive external tool use.

name: Local-First Personal App
best_for: Small privacy-sensitive personal tools that should stay local-first unless account or sync requirements are explicit.
quality_gates: local-first rationale documented before stack selection
no unnecessary auth or hosted database
privacy note attached to stored personal data
known_limits: Not suitable for team collaboration or multi-device sync without additional requirements.
